interface.signature: def doctorStrange(N: int, M: int, graph: List[List[int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: N and M are within the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in graph)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the graph are within the valid range [1, N].
The graph has exactly M edges.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in range(1, N + 1) if is_articulation_point(N, graph, node))
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of nodes whose removal disconnects the graph, where is_articulation_point(N, graph, node) is true if removing node disconnects the graph.
